articles.detail: 5 cycles, all completed; avg 12 published per cycle (59, same as yesterday); 0 quarantined

experiment: Skipped. No experiment is active, and the pause gate (`noNewExperimentsUntil` 2026-11-05) still bars a new one for one more day; the only miss, science at 4/day, is supply-bound and the science floor is not to be raised to chase it.
weakestArea: Science fell to 4 (from 6), under its 5/day target, and ran under its per-cycle floor of 2 in four of five cycles (one cycle at 0). Selectors named the same supply each time: barred Scientific Reports papers, Nature-family methods papers, Carbon Brief COP policy pieces and space-industry announcements, with Quanta, New Scientist and SciDev.Net largely silent; one of the four (Swift's reentry) rests on Breitbart alone. The lever is wider science sources, not a higher floor.
watching: US midterms: Democrats won the House and the Senate, with the Iran war and fuel prices cited as the drivers and Musk's $500 million and AIPAC's $55 million failing to hold seats.
Markets after the midterms: the dollar fell against the yen and franc, Brent slipped below $100 on peace hopes, and bitcoin dropped on doubts over the CLARITY Act.
Hormuz: four tankers ablaze after mine strikes amid continuing US strikes on Iran.
Pakistan: emergency and governor's rule are on the table in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa as the opposition objects.
South Africa: 110 hung councils are in coalition talks after the local elections.
Europe's cyber front: a Russian hosting provider wiped, the Kyiv Independent hit, and French blood banks' refrigeration attacked.
coverageGaps: Science: research findings from top journals were scarce all day; four cycles missed the science floor of 2.
Midterm results dominated the AM count (20 of 59), while US datelines sat exactly at the 25% ceiling.
context: Every other target was met: multi-source 32%, US datelines 25% (at the ceiling), Latin America 8% (up from 4%, with Brazil, Honduras and El Salvador), zero duplicates and zero missing datelines. The pause gate expires 2026-11-05; tomorrow's tuner should drop the field and, if science stays short, consider a science-source addition to CURATED_SOURCES rather than a floor change.
